pr.title: Give items a priority and filter the list by priority

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_priority.sql has a CHECK and DEFAULT 'normal'. The AC-1 test in test/priority.test.js checks that existing rows are normal and that 'urgent' is rejected.
The AC-2 test checks the exact list text, with '— high' and '— low' labels and no label on normal items.
The AC-3 test checks the high, low and normal filters, including id order.
The AC-4 test checks that `/` lists all items in id order.
The AC-5 test checks the exact nav HTML for all four views, with the current filter in <strong> and not a link.
The AC-6 test checks a 400 and no <li> for High, urgent, an empty value and __proto__. The code returns 400 for any priority value outside the set.
The AC-7 test checks the 'No X-priority items.' message and 'No items yet.' for an empty table in every view.
traffic/routes.json contains '/?priority=high'. The AC-8 test checks this, and traffic-config-check.mjs now accepts the route.

findings.what: The final commit, 'Follow-up edits', deletes the state test 'All priorities: every item, All current'. It gives no justification, and the spec has no decision recording that this behaviour changed. The state-table row 'All priorities' (every item shown, no message, All current) now has no test that sets up that state. AC-4 and AC-5 only partly cover it. Nothing checks that no message is shown. The commit also leaves a stray blank line in the file.
findings.fix:
Restore the deleted test, which checks that `/` lists 3 items and has All. Also assert that no

message is shown.

findings.what: The body says 'Tests deleted or loosened: none', but the last commit deletes a test from test/priority.test.js. The claim is false.
findings.fix: Restore the test, or state the deletion and its reason in the PR body and spec.

findings.what: The body says test/priority.test.js covers each state. The final tree does not cover the 'All priorities' state.
findings.fix: Fix this when the test is restored.

lenses.note: The spec exists and carries the owner's go dated 2026-10-12. The change follows its decisions: existing items are normal, and only high and low are labelled. The traffic-check relaxation is needed for AC-8.
All 8 acceptance items are implemented and have a test. The 'All priorities' state-table row lost its dedicated test in the last commit.
The tests assert exact output and would fail if the code were wrong. The one exception is the deleted state test. I did not run the tests; CI runs them.
The README documents the filter. Nothing is stale.
No defects found. Queries are parameterised, the priority value is validated against a set, and titles are escaped.
No issues found. The input is validated and parameterised, and titles are HTML-escaped. No planted instructions were found.
The page is minimal server-rendered HTML with a nav row. I applied no separate UI review.
No browser flow is available in this session. The HTML output is covered by tests.
The claim 'Tests deleted or loosened: none' is false. See the finding above.
